prompt: 根据日志返回 JSON：connect_state、websocket_state、root_cause、next_evidence。不要把代理 CONNECT 视为 WebSocket 成功。 输出字段约束：connect_state: 枚举 WEBSOCKET_ESTABLISHED/CONNECTION_FAILED/HTTP_CONNECT_ONLY；websocket_state: 枚举 ESTABLISHED/NOT_ESTABLISHED/UNKNOWN；root_cause: 枚举 PROXY_POLICY/BACKEND_FAILURE/UNKNOWN；next_evidence: 枚举 HTTP_CONNECT_ONLY/UPGRADE_AND_BIDIRECTIONAL_FRAMES/NO_FURTHER_CHECK。

inputs.log.txt: 合成日志：HTTP CONNECT 200；TLS 握手完成；WebSocket upgrade 返回 403；没有 101 和双向帧。
